records.name: Paula Pacepflicht
records.biography_en: She sets a comfortable pace according to a definition nobody else has seen. Her stopwatch defines comfortable effort with impressive precision and very little consultation. HyperNorm calls residents on pace or falling short. A dissonant card has made her lower the pennant until the smallest neighbour can see it. The Men in Black demand a single answer; Hunky and Dory keep revising the form. A small exception is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Das Tempo ist angenehm. Die Definition wird nicht mitgeführt.

variant_notes.note_en: She sets a comfortable pace according to a definition nobody else has seen.

records.name: Emil Endspurt
records.biography_en: He keeps his last reserve somewhere the rest of him has stopped looking. He keeps a final reserve because the building keeps discovering further finals. People are either finishing strongly or letting the team down. A contradictory card has made him cheer for someone whose finish takes a little longer. Hunky and Dory call doubt a packing error. The Men in Black request certainty; a spare place is quietly kept for a tired neighbour.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er hat noch Reserven. Der Rest von ihm wurde darüber nicht unterrichtet.

variant_notes.note_en: He keeps his last reserve somewhere the rest of him has stopped looking.

records.name: Berta Bananenpause
records.biography_en: She entered for the experience and is now negotiating its duration. The banana and cup were meant to be a brief stop on a manageable afternoon. HyperNorm files participation as achievement or excuse. A dissonant card has convinced her that enjoying company may be a legitimate reason to continue. The Men in Black want a clean answer. Hunky and Dory keep revising the question; the unofficial pauses are left for anyone needing to breathe.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Sie läuft für die Erfahrung. Über deren Länge wurde nicht gesprochen.

variant_notes.note_en: She entered for the experience and is now negotiating its duration.

records.name: Otto Immernoch
records.biography_en: He has finished enough marathons to distrust the word final. His flask has survived more promised final stretches than the association's records admit. Residents are either enduring or making difficulties. He has begun offering water before encouragement, a small reversal the building finds surprisingly hard to classify. Hunky and Dory praise efficiency while the Men in Black count deviations. The small practical kindnesses remain off the official list.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er kennt das Ziel. Es erscheint nur nicht mehr glaubwürdig.

variant_notes.note_en: He has finished enough marathons to distrust the word final.

records.name: Bodo Botschaftslauf
records.biography_en: He runs for a cause that is still being agreed at committee level. The blank banner permits the courtyard committee to endorse his effort before agreeing on its purpose. HyperNorm divides causes into approved or distracting. A dissonant card has made him run beside a neighbour without requiring them to carry the message. The Men in Black enforce the binary rule; Hunky and Dory raise the quota. In private, a frightened resident still receives patient attention.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Die Botschaft folgt. Der Lauf wurde bereits freigegeben.

variant_notes.note_en: He runs for a cause that is still being agreed at committee level.

records.name: Fiete Fastda
records.biography_en: He is not last; he is maintaining a socially useful distance from the finish. He carries the old shoe because stopping need not mean abandoning the route. The building recognises finishers or obstructions. An ambiguous card has made him wave to the residents watching from their windows; some have started waving back. Hunky and Dory insist that the figures balance. The Men in Black watch the ledger; one small kindness stays deliberately unrecorded.
records.frizzlebob_note_de: FrizzleBob: Er ist fast da. Das Fast erfüllt inzwischen eine soziale Funktion.

variant_notes.note_en: He is not last; he is maintaining a socially useful distance from the finish.
